The cases call tvKey(s, key, local) with the card's events unchanged. (2) Case 5 also asserts the call's onFail {busy:false}, as Topics does. 'Six more' and Topics now share one Out.set(local, topic) helper, which also respects running(s,'practice') from desk-pipelines A, so the set goes through the practice job with its 409 guard. (3) continueCard: the 'Half walked' branch (go 'walk') is replaced by the marked branch (go 'sheet', k 'Marked', 'Back to the marked set'). Continue gains focus, so Enter on the card lands on the sheet's first item to look at; KEYMAP.tonight passes cont.focus to nav. The poster's Back goes to Tonight (not Topics) and keeps the set. (5) Case 4 also covers Left/Right/Down/Up on the sheet. Case 6 also checks that Enter on Tonight's card goes to nav sheet focus 1. Case 3 also checks that a verdict settled by an explanation (desk-pipelines B) is what the tile shows. One extra test beyond the card checks that sheetRows.ts carries no runtime require of store/learners. (6) The optional Playwright capture through next dev is not runnable here (the linked desk/node_modules has no @next/env). Instead, Sheet and Walk were rendered server-side with react-dom/server from a scratch script in the OS temp dir. The markup was wrapped in on-air.css and screenshotted with the operator's tools/ Playwright at 1920x1080 in four states: slip focused, Six more focused, all right, walk last item. Results: exactly 1 .band per screen; nothing outside the safe zone; no question text or studentAnswer in the sheet markup. The only text under 28 px is the system's shared furniture (eyebrow 22, cap chip 26, ticker 26); the new .tile classes are 120 and 30 px.
